items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: Segmented YoRHa gauge bar on Base UI Progress. Determinate shows the percentage in aria-valuenow and aria-valuetext; indeterminate omits aria-valuenow and sweeps a block across the track for three passes, then rests.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Square Enix or PlatinumGames. The gauge seams are a CSS gradient; no original assets are used.
